summary: Tested Send Application Link feature for Hiring section. All backend APIs working correctly (16/16 tests passed). Frontend components verified: SendApplicationLinkSection renders and expands, send invite modal with template selection and field customization works, InvitedApplicationPage shows error for invalid tokens. One missing UI feature identified: 'invited' badge not displayed in job applications list when reviewing applications submitted via invite link.

issues.description: Missing 'invited' badge in job applications list view. When admin reviews job applications, applications submitted via invite link should show an 'invited' badge to distinguish them from regular applications. The backend correctly stores the 'invited' field but the frontend FormSubmissionsSection.jsx does not display it.

action_items: Add 'invited' badge to job applications list in FormSubmissionsSection.jsx for applications where invited=true
seed_data_creation: Test invites created during backend tests with unique UUIDs - automatically cleaned up or can be deleted via admin UI
context_for_next_testing_agent: Send Application Link feature fully tested. Key features verified: 1) SendApplicationLinkSection component renders in Hiring section with invite count, 2) Send invite modal allows email input, template selection (Please Apply/Onboarding), custom message, and required field customization, 3) Sent invites list shows status badges (Sent/Completed) with delete buttons, 4) InvitedApplicationPage shows error for invalid tokens with 'Go to Homepage' button, 5) Backend APIs all working: send invite, list invites, email pool, get invite details, submit invited application, delete invite. One improvement needed: add 'invited' badge to job applications list view.

backend_send_invite_api.details: POST /api/admin/application-invites/send works with both generic and onboarding templates

backend_list_invites_api.details: GET /api/admin/application-invites returns list with correct structure (id, email, status, sent_at, template)

backend_email_pool_api.details: GET /api/admin/email-pool returns emails from job applications and interview requests

backend_get_invite_details_api.details: GET /api/forms/application-invite/{token} returns invite details or 404 for invalid token

backend_submit_invited_application_api.details: POST /api/forms/application-invite/{token} creates application with invited=true and alt_contact fields

frontend_send_application_link_section.details: SendApplicationLinkSection renders in Hiring section, expands to show invite button and sent invites list

frontend_send_invite_modal.details: Modal shows email input, template selection (Please Apply/Onboarding), custom message, required fields checkboxes

frontend_invited_application_page.details: InvitedApplicationPage shows 'Link Invalid' error for invalid tokens with Go to Homepage button

frontend_invited_badge_in_list.details: Job applications list does not show 'invited' badge for applications submitted via invite link
